'''LIN-V8K''' was a [[LIN demolitionmech autonomous minelayer]]—a model of [[Color|black]]-plated [[Class five droid|fifth-degree]] [[mining droid]]<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" />—that was amongst the [[droid]]s offered for sale to the [[Lars homestead]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] by a group of [[Jawa]]s<ref name="ANH" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas Updated">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> The Jawas had traveled across the [[Dune Sea]] [[desert]] in a [[sandcrawler]] and lined the wares they had for offer up along the side of the vehicle next to the homestead, where [[Owen Lars]], the owner of the homestead, inspected them. Lars chose not to purchase LIN-V8K, instead selecting the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]]<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> and the [[R5 series astromech droid|R5 unit]] [[R5-D4]],<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> who had been positioned next to the LIN in the line. The R5 unit's motivator proved faulty however, and Lars quickly exchanged it for the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]]. [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s later [[Death|killed]] the Jawas who owned LIN-V8K while trying to locate R2-D2 and C-3PO, leaving the sandcrawler to be later found by Lars' step-nephew [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="ANH" /> LIN-V8K stood 0.56 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Absolutely Everything" />

==Behind the scenes==
LIN-V8K first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH" /> released [[May 25]], [[1977]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The droid went unnamed<ref name="ANH" /> until receiving a card in the "[[Premiere Limited]]" expansion of the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' made by [[Decipher]] and released in [[1995]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=LIN-V8K}}</ref> The name was then first used in [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' reference book,<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> released [[April 4]], [[2017]].<ref name="Release date">{{SW|url=news/new-galaxy-guides-get-a-first-look-at-dks-star-wars-visual-encyclopedia-and-the-amazing-book-of-lego-star-wars|text=New Galaxy Guides: Get a First Look at DK's ''Star Wars Visual Encyclopedia'' and ''The Amazing Book of LEGO Star Wars''}}</ref>
